answer.reason: Italy is the destination of Paul's voyage as a prisoner, and Aquila and Priscilla came from it after Claudius's decree.

clauses.english: was the land Aquila and Priscilla had lately left when Claudius commanded all Jews to depart from Rome
clauses.quote: lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla

clauses.english: was the destination for which Paul and other prisoners were put on a ship to sail
clauses.quote: it was determined that we should sail into Italy

doubts: The note in HEB 13:25 about where the letter was written is a later subscription, not part of the text, so it is left out.
HEB 13:24 only says people of Italy send greetings, so it is not used.
